_note: good.md and fenced-gwt.md pass (fence lines are not items). adjective-ac.md item 3, 'Returns HTTP 200', PASSES on purpose: it records the stated residual — I1 catches adjectives, not criteria that cannot fail. feature-good-mixed.md and bounded-no-contract.md pass: a Contract that embeds real content (even alongside a link to the doc) is not link-only, and a non-feature lane is never asked for one. feature-link-only-long-url.md pins that a >4000-char URL in the link still leaves a link-only Contract/Verify caught — the word count doesn't grow with link length. feature-padded-link.md PASSES on purpose: it documents the known limitation that 8 words of filler in front of a link clears linkOnly()'s word floor. I1 catches linking instead of embedding by mistake, not gaming it on purpose — kept green so the gap is visible, not hidden. seams-one-field-good.md and seams-one-field-list-good.md pass (the merged Seams field: `none: <reason>`, or a list); -bare-none, -none-colon-empty, -prose and -padded fail on the field's shape, since no word count can pad past it. designation-trailer.md passes with a warning: a body whose last non-empty line starts `Per `. seams-one-field-bulleted-none and -bulleted-label fail: a leading bullet does not skip the reason test; -bulleted-none-reason passes. -none-dash and -none-dot fail (a reason holds a letter or digit); -ordered-good and -continuation-good pass; seams-heading-case-old-form.md passes, since the old form is found by the same reader as the section. The shapes the verify of the first fix found (-checkbox-none, -bold-none, -na, -dot, -two-labels, -bold-label) and `label:` with nothing after the colon (-label-empty) fail: every line is `label: detail` after its marker, checkbox and emphasis are taken off. -plus-list-good passes. A padded `a: b` still passes: the check holds the shape, not the meaning. The verify of the narrowing found HTML around a line (-html-label, -html-none, -html-detail, -entity-detail), an invisible letter (-hangul-filler) and a bare URL's colon (-url-only) read as text: all fail now. -none-then-bad, -none-of-these, -no-label, -unlisted-label and -list-then-prose pin clauses of the shape rule. -paren-list-good and -html-in-reason-good pass.
